source: EZbass Key Switch Layout: the PDF installed with EZbass 1.3.4, dated 2026-04-27 - the twelve key switches A-1 to G#0 and the default keyboard range A0 to E4, numbered with C4 = 60. The EZbass manual's reserved MIDI control change messages: CC 1 vibrato, CC 64 sustain, CC 67 soft/damping. The numbering agrees with the 1,256 grooves EZbass installs, measured 2026-09-30: 846 hold notes below 21, and those are 15, 16, 17 and 19 alone, 7,097, 3,718, 1,113 and 94 times; the plug-in's own slide-out macros put 17 and 19 before each note of a slide down and up.
note: name and key are the layout's own. term is this table's choice, not the vendor's. A played note is any pitch in range and is not listed; the keyswitches below the range are.

11.name: Slap/Pop (hold). Play slap sounds if available.

12.name: Left- or Right-Hand Mute (hold). Play mutes if available.

13.name: Middle Finger/Down Stroke. Play only middle finger/down stroke (no alteration).

14.name: Repeater (press). Repeat the last played note.

15.name: Loud Mute (press). Repeat the last played note as a percussive mute.

16.name: Ghost Note (press). Repeat the last played note as a ghost note.

17.name: Slide Down (press). Slide currently playing note down.

18.name: Slide (press and hold). Slide currently playing note to the next note played.

19.name: Slide Up (press). Slide currently playing note up.
